title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function is given as L(theta_0,theta_1)=1/n*sum{i=1}{n}{(y_i-theta_0/(4*theta_1)+theta_1*x_i)**2}. To find the value of $$\theta_0$$ that minimizes this function, consider how $$\theta_0$$ appears in the equation.

title: Partial Derivative with Respect to $$\theta_0$$
text: To find the optimal $$\theta_0$$, take the partial derivative of the objective function with respect to $$\theta_0$$ and set it to zero. This will help you find the critical points.

title: Calculate the Partial Derivative
text: Calculate the partial derivative of $$L(\theta_0,\theta_1)$$ with respect to $$\theta_0$$.

title: Set the Derivative to Zero
text: Set the partial derivative you calculated to zero and solve for $$\theta_0$$.

title: Final Expression for $$\theta_0$$
text: After setting the derivative to zero and solving for $$\theta_0$$, you should find that theta_0=4*theta_1/n*sum{i=1}{n}{(y_i+theta_1*x_i)}. This is the value that minimizes the objective function.
